prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs using only the standard library.
Required API: pub fn decode_hex(text: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>>
Behavior: Decode pairs of ASCII hexadecimal digits, accepting upper or lower case. Reject odd length, non-ASCII, or any non-hex digit; empty input succeeds with an empty byte sequence.
Visible example: "4A00ff" produces bytes [74, 0, 255].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: pub fn decode_hex(s:&str)->Option<Vec<u8>>{if s.len()%2!=0||!s.is_ascii(){return None}fn h(c:u8)->Option<u8>{match c{b'0'..=b'9'=>Some(c-b'0'),b'a'..=b'f'=>Some(c-b'a'+10),b'A'..=b'F'=>Some(c-b'A'+10),_=>None}}let b=s.as_bytes();(0..b.len()).step_by(2).map(|i|Some(h(b[i])?*16+h(b[i+1])?)).collect()}
